old_value: {"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-5j12","title":"Gateway TOFU pins keys without authenticated proof of possession","description":"Security review P1. New TrustStore::verify_tofu in rust/lichen-gateway/src/trust.rs accepts only public key plus claimed IID, verifies deterministic derivation, and immediately returns PinAndAccept/inserts the key. It does not verify a Schnorr signature, OSCORE identity, challenge, or owner-issued authenticated-message capability. An unauthenticated first-contact key claim can pre-pin a gateway identity and block the legitimate key; callers are merely expected to sequence separate helpers correctly. Require proof of possession and message/domain/freshness verification in the atomic pin operation, or accept an opaque verified gateway identity capability; add tests that a derived IID/public key without a valid signed exchange cannot create a pin.","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"bug","owner":"me@mark.atwood.name","created_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:22.232098Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-08-24T12:22:22.232098Z"}
